title: Club Membership: signup eligibility requirements by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states the signup eligibility basis Club Membership applies at the point a prospective member joins, for every tier the club offers.

## Guardian consent basis (all tiers)
A guardian's consent is required for an applicant signing up under the minimum signup age; across every Club Membership tier the minimum age to sign up without a guardian's consent is 16 years, and the guardian-consent requirement itself applies uniformly across every tier. This 16-year guardian-consent threshold is distinct from a tier's own age gate at signup (below), and the two bases are checked separately.

## Per-tier entry gate at signup
Every tier requires the applicant to present valid photo identification. Beyond that common basis, each tier's own age gate and any further signup condition are:
| Tier | Tier's own minimum age at signup | Further signup condition |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 16 | none |
| Student Metro Access | 16 | active student status required at signup; a student ID must also be presented |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 16 | none |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 16 | none |
| Premier All-Access | 16 | none |
| Black Card All-Access | 18 | a credit card on file is required |
| Founding Legacy Access | 16 | the applicant must already have been an existing member before January 1, 2015 |

## Active student status
Only the Student Metro Access tier requires the applicant to hold active student status at signup; no other tier carries this requirement, and only Student Metro Access requires a student ID at signup.

## How the two age bases interact
The 16-year guardian-consent threshold is the same figure across every tier regardless of that tier's own entry-gate minimum age. Because Black Card All-Access's own entry-gate minimum age (18) already sits above the 16-year guardian-consent threshold, an applicant meeting Black Card All-Access's own age gate is never a case in which guardian consent is required under this basis; for every other tier, an applicant signing up between the guardian-consent threshold and that tier's own entry-gate minimum age is not a case this basis distinguishes, since both figures are 16.
